gaps.claim: Remaining flush loss includes worker capacity
gaps.evidence: Fixed16 slower; fixed64 faster; 30s warmup gives 38 workers; virtual workers retain cap

gaps.evidence: Full-scan and spare-capacity controls near CE in three JVMs each; fixed64 default-scan slower in all three
